_about: Every rate the Lead Hammer estimator uses. Prices are what the customer pays for an INSTALLED line (material + labor combined, never shown split). Costs for catalog work come live from the JobTread catalog; the costs here are only for items that have no catalog cost. Edit this file, not the code. See rules.md for how each rate is applied.

rounding._about: Unit prices per LF / SF / square round to the nearest $0.25; each / lump-sum prices round to the nearest $5.

tax._about: Sales tax goes on insurance proposals only. Retail and GC proposals use taxRate 0.

waste._about: Siding: wall area + 10% on material and labor alike; no opening deductions.

gutters._about: Per LF of gutter + downspout footage (box miters count as 3 ft of gutter; no miter line). Tear-off is included in the rate.

customerRates._about: GCs with their own deal, by JobTread customer account id. They are treated as GC for minimums.

minimum._about: Small jobs: the customer's per-foot rate x minimumFeet, rounded to $5, never below the floor.

gutterGuards._about: Bulldog guards installed, per LF. Catalog split: material $6.50 + labor $3 (cost $2.18 + $1). 6-inch has no set price yet: catalog material + labor, rounded.

difficultAccess._about: Tree cover, steep grade drops, or 2nd story.

gutterRepairs._about: Repair and odd-job presets. Prices are starting points; every house differs, so Sean adjusts per job. None carry a lifetime warranty.

reslope.name: Re-slope gutters to new downspout locations

removeGuards.name: Remove improperly installed gutter guards & seal roof

drainage._about: In-ground downspout drains, installed. Home Depot materials only. Concrete always quoted by a sub first; no fixed price promised with concrete, long runs, roots or landscaping.

siding._about: Per sq ft of wall area x waste. Labor is always estimated at Alex Romero's rates (includes trim and house wrap install). Painting (LP/Hardie) is absorbed into the siding price.

styleRatesPerSF._about: Board & batten and shake areas (LP and Hardie), same margin as lap. Vinyl shake areas use the vinylShake rates.

tearOffPerSF._about: Installed price per SF torn off (catalog $0.90 / $3.60 / $3.60, rounded to quarters).

resheathPerSF._about: OSB + labor per SF resheathed (catalog $0.79 x 1.1 + $3.60, rounded).

insulatedWrapUpgradePerSF._about: Per SF of wall x waste (catalog $1.80, rounded to quarters).

soffitFascia._about: Aluminum only. Both together per LF; half that for only one of the two.

stucco._about: Luis Martinez. Full jobs per SF on wall area + 10%.

painting._about: Same prices for every customer; costs come from the catalog. Eave painting is its own line.

other._about: Priced per job; these are reference figures for the questionnaire and Claude's review.
